action: Formalized restaurant pilot to signed $300/month contract, activated Angela Wright referral channel, posted original LinkedIn/Instagram content, sent two new cold outreach contacts in RoboRide delivery corridor
narrative: Tamika sent the one-page pilot agreement to the restaurant owner this morning and had a signed copy back by 3pm — the verbal yes from tick 10 is now a receivable at $300/month, bringing total freelance income to $650/month against $3,177 in expenses. Angela Wright responded to the peer-to-peer outreach with warmth and genuine engagement, mentioning a former dealership finance manager named Devon Clarke who recently started a mobile dog grooming business and is struggling to build a social presence — a warm referral that Tamika will activate next tick. The LinkedIn post about foot-traffic patterns and RoboRide residential corridors drew 14 comments from local business owners, two of whom asked follow-up questions in DMs. Two new cold outreach messages went out to a specialty pharmacy on Ridgeline Ave and a coffee kiosk operating near the Route 9 residential cluster — both in the delivery corridor, both with minimal social presence.
